messages.content:
Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-prompt-medium-0069", "row_sha256": "acf931fd55dfff3a0237f36cb7ee1ef714aef0d2c9cfd42acc0e5e70d860b109", "mode": "/prompt", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Organize the supplied request into a clear prompt. Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "could you turn this into a short friendly text for my sister? the courier is booked to collect our sealed return parcel tomorrow between one and five in the afternoon. it's already packed and the label is attached, and it's beside the shoe rack in the hallway. i'll be out for most of that window so she may be the one at home if the driver comes. i want the note to say that if she's home when the driver arrives she should hand over the parcel and ask for a collection receipt. if she's not home when he gets there she shouldn't put the parcel outside or leave it with a neighbor; she should text me instead and i'll arrange another pickup. make it sound like a normal household heads-up rather than a formal instruction, and include the time and where the parcel is so she doesn't have to look around. she doesn't need to contact the courier herself. it's fine if the text is simple, but don't change what she should do in either case.", "output": "Draft a short, friendly text message to my sister as a normal household heads-up, not a formal instruction. The courier is scheduled to collect our sealed return parcel tomorrow between 1 and 5 in the afternoon. The parcel is packed, its label is attached, and it is beside the shoe rack in the hallway. I’ll be out for most of that window, so she may be home when the driver arrives. Include both cases: if she’s home when the driver arrives, she should hand over the parcel and ask for a collection receipt. If she’s not home, she shouldn’t put the parcel outside or leave it with a neighbor; she should text me instead, and I’ll arrange another pickup. Include the pickup time and parcel location so she doesn’t have to look around. She doesn’t need to contact the courier herself. Keep the wording simple, and don’t change what she should do in either case."}]
